bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new water tower in the city of North St. Paul; canceling a prior appropriation for the city of North St. Paul.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. NORTH ST. PAUL; WATER TOWER.

$4,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of North St. Paul to design, construct, and equip a new water tower. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

Sec. 2. CANCELLATION.

The $4,500,000 appropriation from the general fund in Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 14, subdivision 30, for capital improvements to the community outreach facility in the city of North St. Paul is canceled.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

The $4,500,000 appropriation from the general fund in Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 14, subdivision 30, for capital improvements to the community outreach facility in the city of North St. Paul is canceled.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
